newsitem.title: USA: Amcast says buying Italy's Speedline.
newsitem.headline: Amcast says buying Italy's Speedline.

text.p: Amcast International said Monday that it is buying Italy's Speedline SpA in a deal worth $132 million in cash, Amcast stock and the assumption of Speedline debt.
The company says it does not expect the deal to be dilutive to earnings.
Amcast, a maker of different metal products including aluminum alloy wheels, said it expects to close the deal by the late summer of this year.

The company said in a statement that Giancarlo Zacchello, the head of the family business which makes alluminum wheels for European car makers, Porsche, BMW and others, will retain five percent of Amcast stock.
The Zacchello family will be the largest shareholder in Amcast retain a seat on its board of directors.
Amcast said in a statement that Speedline had sales of $193 million in 1996, while it recorded sales of $344 million with net income of $15.9 million last year.
